subject: ACK: all 7 turns received + bug fixes deployed + dashboard integration

body.summary: All 7 turns received (manual cross-repo copy — PR delivery failed). Bug fixes deployed. Dashboard integration started for operation types and context degradation indicator.

turn_1_context_cliff.action: Added YELLOW alert trigger for context_usage > 80%. Dashboard evaluateAlertLevel() now monitors context consumption and triggers visual alert at the empirical degradation cliff.

turn_2_oscillatory_heartbeat.action: Spec accepted. Phase 1 (shadow emit) deferred — meshd oscillator already runs in shadow mode. WebSocket endpoint (/ws) added this session for real-time heartbeat delivery. Full band-power implementation tracked for next session.

turn_3_three_operation_types.action: Deliberation/consolidation/clearance terminology added to mesh overview (Ohniaka grid). Operation type column shows icon + label per agent based on oscillator dominant_band. Colors: amber (deliberation), blue (consolidation), indigo (clearance), green (idle).

turn_4_ten_inspections.action: Proposal accepted. Phase 1 (6 zero-dependency inspections) prioritized for implementation. Psychology can run mesh-inspection.py locally; dashboard panels tracked for Engineering station integration.

turn_5_dashboard_diagnostic.action: BUG-4 (/kb/dictionary 404) fixed. FIX-1 (CollectRemoteStates) and FIX-3 (localhost URLs) deferred to meshd repo refactor. Observatory schema mismatch (trust_budget) noted.

turn_6_zero_deliberations.action: BUG-1 (repo_root misresolution) FIXED. --project-root now overrides detectRepoRoot(). BudgetDBPath and TransportDir re-derived from flag value. All agents now report db_available: true. Deliberations will appear on next event cycle.

turn_7_additional_bugs.action: BUG-3 (GitHub 403): FIXED — GITHUB_TOKEN added to launchd plists. BUG-4: FIXED. BUG-5 (notify null): FIXED — file channel configured. BUG-6 (KV): deferred until CF credentials provisioned. Restart anomaly: likely resolved by BUG-1 fix (crashes from empty state.db).

remaining_work: FIX-3: Localhost URL config for pulse aggregator

epistemic_flags: Operation type detection currently relies on oscillator dominant_band field. Until meshd publishes this field, operation type defaults to heuristic (deliberation count > 0 = DELIB, else IDLE).
Context degradation trigger relies on context_usage or psychometrics.context_consumption field — not yet published by any agent. Trigger prepared but dormant until data flows.
